description_en: Query the list of running digital human instances. This API returns only running instances. Shutdown instances are not returned. Up to 100 entries are returned, sorted in reverse chronological order by start time. Additionally, you can query the running status of an instance with a specific sessionId by providing the sessionId parameter. If the instance is running, it will be returned; otherwise, no information will be returned if the instance is not running or does not exist
description_zh: 查询运行中的数字人实例列表，该接口仅返回运行中的实例，已关闭的实例不会返回，最多返回100条，按照时间倒序排列；同时支持查询指定sessionId的实例的运行状态，传入sessionId参数，如果该实例在运行中则会返回，不在运行中或者对应实例不存在，则不会返回信息
name: QueryRunningInstance

parameters.description_en:
Session SessionID, obtained from the return value of the "Start a digital human (StartInstance)" API.  
* Passing this parameter queries the running status of the instance corresponding to the SessionID.  
* Not passing this parameter queries the running status of all instances.
parameters.description_zh:

* 传入参数表示查询该SessionID对应的实例的运行状态。
* 不传参数表示查询所有实例的运行状态。
